title: Make an evenly spaced row
summary: MATLAB: Make an evenly spaced row. Use a step of 1.
introduction: The colon form start:step:end builds evenly spaced values. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Make an evenly spaced row with MATLAB

blocks.text: Use MATLAB. Paste one example into the Command Window, or save it as a .m script and run the script. A MATLAB licence may be required.
The range starts at 1 and steps by 2, reaching 3 and 5.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The middle number is a step size, not an item count.

seo.description: MATLAB: Make an evenly spaced row. Use a step of 1. Follow a small example and practise the idea.
